Plot Seasonal Adjustment Objects

Source: R/autoplot.R
autoplot_ggdemetra3.Rd

Plot Seasonal Adjustment Objects

Usage

# S3 method for class 'JD3_X13_OUTPUT'
autoplot(
  object,
  components = c("y", "sa", trend = "t", seasonal = "s", irregular = "i"),
  forecast = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'JD3_TRAMOSEATS_OUTPUT'
autoplot(
  object,
  components = c("y", "sa", trend = "t", seasonal = "s", irregular = "i"),
  forecast = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'JD3_X13_RSLTS'
autoplot(
  object,
  components = c("y", "sa", trend = "t", seasonal = "s", irregular = "i"),
  forecast = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'JD3_TRAMOSEATS_RSLTS'
autoplot(
  object,
  components = c("y", "sa", trend = "t", seasonal = "s", irregular = "i"),
  forecast = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'JD3_Object'
autoplot(
  object,
  components = c("y", "sa", trend = "t", seasonal = "s", irregular = "i"),
  forecast = FALSE,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'hf_decomposition'
autoplot(
  object,
  components = c("y", "sa", trend = "t", seasonal = "s", irregular = "i"),
  dates = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

A seasonal adjustment model (from rjd3x13, rjd3tramoseats, or rjd3highfreq).

components

Components to display. Can be "y" (input time series), "sa" (seasonally adjusted), "t" (trend-cycle), "y_cal" (calendar-adjusted), "s" (seasonal), "i" (irregular), and "cal" (calendar). The vector can be named to change the strip label.

forecast

Logical indicating whether the forecast series should be plotted (default is FALSE). Ignored for "hf_decomposition" objects (rjd3highfreq).

...

Additional arguments passed to methods.

dates

For "hf_decomposition" objects (rjd3highfreq), a numeric or date vector corresponding to the time series. If NULL, a sequence of integers is used. For models created with rjd3highfreq::fractional_airline_decomposition() or rjd3highfreq::multi_airline_decomposition(), the series_time parameter is used if available.

Value

A ggplot2 object representing the faceted components.

Examples

autoplot(rjd3x13::jx13(ipi_c_eu[, "FR"]))


# \donttest{
hf_data <- usclaims[usclaims$date <= "2019-12-01",]
mod_hf <- rjd3highfreq::fractional_airline_decomposition(
  hf_data[, "Initial claims"], 
  period = 52,
  series_time = hf_data[, "date"]
)
autoplot(mod_hf, dates = usclaims$date[usclaims$date <= "2019-12-01"])

# }
